module: Flowgraph node "Pursuit Information" (repeat_instant). Gives the police pursuit state of a vehicle (vehId, otherwise the player) via gameplay_police.getPursuitData: active, arrest/evade (pulses), mode (0 off, 1-3 pursuit, -1 arrested), score, sightValue, arrestValue, evadeValue, timeElapsed, roadblocks, collisions, policeWrecks, offenses, uniqueOffenses, offensesList.
notes: The values are kept one more frame after an arrest/evade (flags) before being refreshed.

onPursuitAction.desc: Hook called by the police system; remembers 'arrest' or 'evade' if id matches the tracked vehicle.

reset.desc: Resets the vehicle, the flow outputs and the flags.

work.desc: Reads the pursuit data and updates the outputs; emits arrest/evade for one frame.
